monthly_sales.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(amount) AS sales FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 200
monthly_sales.answer: Sales increased steadily this year, reaching a peak of $1,284,000 in June, up about 42% from January.
followups: Break down sales by product category

regional_sales.sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 200
regional_sales.answer: The East region contributes the most, representing about 43% of demo sales.
